# Storage engine support matrix

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/docs/generate_engine_matrix_doc.py from scripts/policy/engine-capability-matrix.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

Which storage engine supports which capability, and **which CI job proves it**. A cell is a claim, never an assumption: `supported` and `partial` name a real job under `.github/workflows/`, and `scripts/quality/check-engine-matrix.py` fails when a claim points at a job that does not exist.

- **supported**: a CI job exercises the capability on that engine.
- **partial**: a job exercises part of it; the note under the engine says what is and is not covered.
- **not proven**: no CI job proves it. This does *not* mean the code path is missing; the note says which.

A green local run on H2 or in compatibility mode is not a witness for MySQL or SQL Server.

## At a glance

| Capability | H2 | PostgreSQL | MySQL | SQL Server |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| boot | supported | supported | supported | supported |
| additive migration | partial | supported | supported | supported |
| destructive migration ack | partial | not proven | not proven | not proven |
| promotion target | not proven | not proven | not proven | not proven |
| backup | supported | not proven | not proven | supported |
| restore drill | partial | not proven | not proven | supported |
| pagination | supported | supported | supported | supported |
| json search | not proven | not proven | not proven | not proven |
| flow durability | partial | supported | not proven | not proven |

## H2

### boot: supported

- Witness: [`journeys.yml#journeys`](../../.github/workflows/journeys.yml) (job `journeys`)
- NPDevSamples/journeys is an H2Local jwt app generated, built, booted on a wiped DB and driven over REST and a real browser on every push to main and nightly.

### additive migration: partial

- Witness: [`npdev-ci-validation.yml#ci-validation`](../../.github/workflows/npdev-ci-validation.yml) (job `ci-validation`)
- The RuntimeHost gate runs the runtimehost-core suite (MissingTableCreationPassTest, NewConceptSchemaProvisionerTest, MigrationPreflightTest on H2). No booted-app Tier C evolution vector runs on H2.

### destructive migration ack: partial

- Witness: [`npdev-ci-validation.yml#ci-validation`](../../.github/workflows/npdev-ci-validation.yml) (job `ci-validation`)
- SurplusDropFlowH2Test and the schema-drop snapshot tests run in the RuntimeHost gate against a real H2; the acknowledgment REST flow on a booted app is not driven in CI.

### promotion target: not proven

- Witness: none
- H2 is the SOURCE of `npdev db promote` (H2 -> Postgres etc.). No CI job promotes into an H2 target.

### backup: supported

- Witness: [`npdev-ci-validation.yml#ci-validation`](../../.github/workflows/npdev-ci-validation.yml) (job `ci-validation`)
- ScheduledH2BackupTest (OPS-10): online BACKUP TO into a directory with newest-N retention, against a real file H2, inside the RuntimeHost gate.

### restore drill: partial

- Witness: [`npdev-ci-validation.yml#ci-validation`](../../.github/workflows/npdev-ci-validation.yml) (job `ci-validation`)
- DataExportImportRoundTripH2Test and SchemaVaultStoreTest prove the data export/snapshot restore round trip; no test restores a ScheduledH2Backup zip into a fresh database and boots the app on it.

### pagination: supported

- Witness: [`kernel-quality-gate.yml#kernel-quality-gate`](../../.github/workflows/kernel-quality-gate.yml) (job `kernel-quality-gate`)
- kernelQualityGate runs :kernel:test, whose DialectConformanceTierBTest vectors (limit, non-overlapping pages, offset past the end) run against H2 by default.

### json search: not proven

- Witness: none
- No engine-side JSON path query exists in the kernel or runtime-support (no JSON_VALUE / jsonb operators). Only JSON round-trip storage is witnessed (vectors J1/J2).

### flow durability: partial

- Witness: [`kernel-quality-gate.yml#kernel-quality-gate`](../../.github/workflows/kernel-quality-gate.yml) (job `kernel-quality-gate`)
- JdbcFlowInstanceStoreClaimTest (in flowinstance-postgres) proves the SKIP LOCKED claim/lease against a real H2 (no double-resume, expired claim reclaimable). No test kills the process and resumes a waiting flow from H2.


## PostgreSQL

### boot: supported

- Witness: [`engine-support.yml#app-on-engine`](../../.github/workflows/engine-support.yml) (job `app-on-engine`)
- A generated app boots, serves CRUD, round-trips non-BMP unicode and preserves rows across a restart against the pinned postgres image (matrix leg postgres).

### additive migration: supported

- Witness: [`engine-support.yml#app-on-engine`](../../.github/workflows/engine-support.yml) (job `app-on-engine`)
- Tier C E1 (nullable column added, rows preserved) and E2 (renamedFrom moves data) run through NPDev's own schema engine against the real engine.

### destructive migration ack: not proven

- Witness: none
- No real-engine job drives a destructive change through the acknowledgment flow. The mechanism is engine-agnostic and only H2-witnessed; Tier C deliberately forces allowDestructiveRecreate=false.

### promotion target: not proven

- Witness: none
- `npdev db promote` exists and docs name Postgres as the usual target, but no CI job runs a promotion into a real Postgres.

### backup: not proven

- Witness: none
- PostgresDialect declares SNAPSHOT_RESTORE but no conformance vector or job takes a backup; the generated toolbox parity job covers start/stop/status/reset, not backup.

### restore drill: not proven

- Witness: none
- No CI restore drill on Postgres. The pre-drop JSONL snapshot restore (`npdev db restore`) is witnessed on H2 only.

### pagination: supported

- Witness: [`storage-dialect-conformance.yml#conformance`](../../.github/workflows/storage-dialect-conformance.yml) (job `conformance`)
- Tier B against a real pinned Postgres: limitReturnsExactlyN, pagesDoNotOverlapOrGap, offsetPastTheEndReturnsNothing, limitOnlyCaps; app-on-engine also asserts a filtered, ordered query path.

### json search: not proven

- Witness: none
- No JSON path query is implemented. jsonb round-trip is witnessed (storage-dialect-conformance.yml#conformance J1/J2) but that is storage, not search.

### flow durability: supported

- Witness: [`npdev-ci-validation.yml#linux-maturity-validation`](../../.github/workflows/npdev-ci-validation.yml) (job `linux-maturity-validation`)
- flowinstance-postgres Testcontainers tests (PostgresFlowInstanceStoreTest) plus the generated-app Postgres integration tests (AsyncWaitResumeE2EIT) run against a real Postgres. Not run on pull requests.


## MySQL

### boot: supported

- Witness: [`engine-support.yml#app-on-engine`](../../.github/workflows/engine-support.yml) (job `app-on-engine`)
- Same app-on-engine proof as Postgres on the pinned mysql image, forced to utf8mb4 (matrix leg mysql); doctor must also fail a utf8mb3 server (doctor-charset-fixture).

### additive migration: supported

- Witness: [`engine-support.yml#app-on-engine`](../../.github/workflows/engine-support.yml) (job `app-on-engine`)
- Tier C E1/E2 against a real MySQL. MySQL commits DDL implicitly (no DDL_IN_TRANSACTION), so a half-applied migration cannot be rolled back; that is a declared limit, not a gap in this cell.

### destructive migration ack: not proven

- Witness: none
- No real-engine job drives a destructive change through the acknowledgment flow; MySQL's implicit DDL commit makes this the cell most worth a real witness.

### promotion target: not proven

- Witness: none
- No CI job promotes a database into a real MySQL.

### backup: not proven

- Witness: none
- MySqlDialect does not declare SNAPSHOT_RESTORE and no job takes a MySQL backup.

### restore drill: not proven

- Witness: none
- No CI restore drill on MySQL.

### pagination: supported

- Witness: [`storage-dialect-conformance.yml#conformance`](../../.github/workflows/storage-dialect-conformance.yml) (job `conformance`)
- Tier B against a real pinned MySQL 8.4 (same vectors as Postgres), plus the app-on-engine query path.

### json search: not proven

- Witness: none
- No JSON path query is implemented; JSON column round-trip is witnessed (J1/J2), search is not.

### flow durability: not proven

- Witness: none
- docs/FLOWS.md names JdbcFlowInstanceStore for Postgres/H2 only; no CI job resumes a waiting flow on MySQL.


## SQL Server

### boot: supported

- Witness: [`engine-support.yml#app-on-engine`](../../.github/workflows/engine-support.yml) (job `app-on-engine`)
- Same app-on-engine proof on the pinned mssql/server:2022 image (matrix leg sqlserver), including the non-BMP unicode assertion that originally exposed the VARCHAR/NVARCHAR gap.

### additive migration: supported

- Witness: [`engine-support.yml#app-on-engine`](../../.github/workflows/engine-support.yml) (job `app-on-engine`)
- Tier C E1/E2 against a real SQL Server.

### destructive migration ack: not proven

- Witness: none
- No real-engine job drives a destructive change through the acknowledgment flow.

### promotion target: not proven

- Witness: none
- No CI job promotes a database into a real SQL Server.

### backup: supported

- Witness: [`engine-support.yml#app-on-engine`](../../.github/workflows/engine-support.yml) (job `app-on-engine`)
- The generated `backup` sidecar takes a BACKUP DATABASE ... CHECKSUM .bak into ./backups on the pinned mssql/server image (sqlserver leg, 'Backup drill' steps).

### restore drill: supported

- Witness: [`engine-support.yml#app-on-engine`](../../.github/workflows/engine-support.yml) (job `app-on-engine`)
- The generated `backup-verify` job restores that .bak into a scratch server, DBCC CHECKDB passes and the seeded rows read back (sqlserver leg, 'Backup drill' steps).

### pagination: supported

- Witness: [`storage-dialect-conformance.yml#conformance`](../../.github/workflows/storage-dialect-conformance.yml) (job `conformance`)
- Tier B against a real pinned SQL Server 2022 (OFFSET/FETCH spelling), plus the app-on-engine query path.

### json search: not proven

- Witness: none
- No JSON path query is implemented; JSON is stored as nvarchar(max) and only its round-trip is witnessed (J1/J2).

### flow durability: not proven

- Witness: none
- docs/FLOWS.md names JdbcFlowInstanceStore for Postgres/H2 only; no CI job resumes a waiting flow on SQL Server.
